module.purpose: Defines CollectionStateManager class which manages collection state including synced data, optimistic mutations, transactions, virtual properties ($synced, $origin, $key, $collectionId), and change event emission for a database collection with sync capabilities.
module.summary: The CollectionStateManager class is the core state management component for a collection in a database system with optimistic UI updates and sync capabilities. It maintains both authoritative synced data from the server and optimistic local mutations, tracking their origins ($synced, $origin virtual properties). The class handles transaction lifecycle, computes derived state from optimistic and synced data, emits change events, and manages virtual properties enrichment for rows and change messages. It provides a map-like interface (get, has, keys, values, entries, forEach, map) over the virtual derived state.
module.businessContext: This file serves the database synchronization layer, enabling offline-first applications with optimistic UI updates. Critical for maintaining data consistency between client-side mutations and server-confirmed state. Failures cause data loss or inconsistent UI state.

units.name: get
units.source:
change: ChangeMessage<TOutput, TKey>,
  ): ChangeMessage<WithVirtualProps<TOutput, TKey>, TKey> {
    const { __virtualProps } = change as InternalChangeMessage<TOutput, TKey>
    const enrichedValue = __virtualProps?.value
      ? this.enrichWithVirtualPropsSnapshot(change.value, __virtualProps.value)
      : this.enrichWithVirtualProps(change.value, change.key)
    const enrichedPreviousValue = change.previousValue
      ? __virtualProps?.previousValue
        ? this.enrichWithVirtualPropsSnapshot(
            change.previousValue,
            __virtualProps.previousValue,
          )
        : this.enrichWithVirtualProps(change.previousValue, change.key)
